title: ExploreMC
description: A modpack for people who like to explore more than build.
body:
Explore MC is a modpack designed for..... you guessed it, exploration!
It includes mods such as Biomes a'plenty and various YUNG'S better structure mods to make your world look wonderful.
With Essential installed, you can play by yourself or with friends.
There are many ease of access mods, such as Fullbright, Immediately Fast and JEI.
If you want to add a twist to your game, why not choose an origin. With Origins installed you can be anything from an enderman to an elytrian.
This modpack also has several anti lag mods, meaning you don't need a beast of a pc to play it.

I hope you enjoy ExploreMC.
